title: billing / wallet.topped_up (v1) data payload
description: Billing (the stored-value ledger system-of-record) CREDITED a wallet after a confirmed load (Round 17, ADR-0011). Published to 'billing.events' with routing key 'wallet.topped_up'; caused by a 'payment.captured'. Consumed by Frontend (account balance read-model), Bar/POS (local balance copy for spend), Control Room. 'balanceAfter' carries the authoritative balance (ECST). Non-taxable load (MPV).

balanceAfter.description: Authoritative wallet balance after this credit (ECST: consumers replace, not accumulate).

sourcePaymentId.description: The payment.captured paymentId that funded this top-up (trace + idempotency).

at.description: When the ledger applied the credit (RFC3339 UTC).
